methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing collected for the 2025 tax year (returns filed in 2026). TurboTax product pages were fetched directly from turbotax.intuit.com and returned live prices. TaxAct pricing was fetched directly from taxact.com and returned live prices ($59.99/$99.99/$109.99 for Deluxe/Premier/Self-Employed; some comparison aggregators show lower promotional figures from earlier in the season). Cash App Taxes pricing was confirmed directly from cash.app/taxes. H&R Block, FreeTaxUSA, and TaxSlayer blocked direct fetches with HTTP 403; their prices were sourced from SmartAsset dedicated per-vendor review pages (smartasset.com), which are corroborated against the SmartAsset tax software comparison page. Tax filing software bills per-return (one-time annual fee), not monthly subscriptions; monthlyUsd reflects the per-filing fee for the smallest available unit (a single federal return). annualDiscountPct is null for all plans because there is no monthly vs. annual billing distinction — all plans are single-season purchases. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null throughout (non-telephony product). hipaa and baa are null for all vendors (personal tax filing is not a HIPAA-regulated healthcare context). State filing fees are noted in plan notes but are not included in monthlyUsd since they are per-state add-ons, not the base plan price.
